activeKey.zh-CN: 当前激活的标签页的 itemKey，可用 `bind:activeKey` 双向绑定。传 `null` 时不激活任何标签页，仍是受控；不传或为 `undefined` 时按非受控处理，默认选中第一个启用的标签页。
activeKey.en-US: The itemKey of the active tab, bound with `bind:activeKey`. `null` activates no tab and is still controlled; omitted or `undefined` means uncontrolled, with the first enabled tab selected.

arrow.zh-CN: 替换折叠模式下每个滚动箭头的 snippet，参数为 `{ items, position, onClick, defaultNode }`：被滚出的标签页、位置、点击处理函数和默认箭头（用 `{@render defaultNode()}` 渲染）。
arrow.en-US: Snippet that replaces each scroll arrow in collapsible mode, with `{ items, position, onClick, defaultNode }`: the scrolled-out tabs, the position, the click handler and the default arrow (render it with `{@render defaultNode()}`).

arrowPosition.zh-CN: 折叠模式下，左右切换箭头的位置。
arrowPosition.en-US: Position of the scroll arrows in collapsible mode.

children.zh-CN: 没有 `panel` 时的内容区：当前标签页的内容，是以所选标签命名的单个 tabpanel。
children.en-US: The content area when there is no `panel`: the content of the active tab, one tabpanel labelled by the selected tab.

collapsible.zh-CN: 是否开启滚动折叠（仅水平模式）。传 `'auto'` 时在标签溢出或换行时自动折叠，放得下时自动退出。
collapsible.en-US: Whether to collapse overflowing tabs into a scrollable bar (horizontal mode only). `'auto'` collapses when the tabs overflow or wrap and leaves the collapse once they fit.

contentStyle.zh-CN: 内容区域外层的样式字符串。
contentStyle.en-US: Style string of the outer content area.

dropdownProps.zh-CN: 折叠模式下，分别透传给起始侧与末尾侧箭头下拉菜单的 Dropdown 属性。
dropdownProps.en-US: In collapsible mode, the Dropdown props passed to the start-side and end-side arrow menus.

icon.zh-CN: `tabList` 中每个标签页图标的 snippet，参数为 `{ item, index }`；图标容器始终渲染，即使 snippet 没有输出。
icon.en-US: Snippet for the icon of each `tabList` entry, with `{ item, index }`; the icon container renders even when the snippet outputs nothing.

keepDOM.zh-CN: 使用 `panel` 时，是否渲染未激活面板的 DOM。为 false 时只渲染当前面板，没有切换动画。
keepDOM.en-US: With `panel`, whether to render the DOM of inactive panels. When false only the active panel is rendered, without motion.

lazyRender.zh-CN: 懒渲染，面板被激活过才渲染进 DOM。
lazyRender.en-US: Lazy rendering: a panel is rendered into the DOM only after it has been active.

more.zh-CN: 将末尾的一部分标签页收入「更多」下拉菜单。传数字表示收入菜单的标签数；传对象时 `count` 为标签数，`dropdownProps` 透传给下拉菜单。触发器与菜单内容分别用 `moreTrigger` 与 `moreContent` snippet 自定义。
more.en-US: Moves the last tabs into a More dropdown. A number is the count of tabs moved; in an object, `count` is that number and `dropdownProps` is passed to the dropdown. The trigger and the menu content are customized with the `moreTrigger` and `moreContent` snippets.

moreContent.zh-CN: 替换「更多」菜单内容的 snippet，参数 `{ items }` 为收入菜单的标签页。
moreContent.en-US: Snippet that replaces the content of the More menu, with the tabs moved into it as `{ items }`.

moreTrigger.zh-CN: 替换「更多」菜单触发器的 snippet。
moreTrigger.en-US: Snippet that replaces the trigger of the More menu.

onChange.zh-CN: 切换标签页时调用，参数为新激活的 itemKey。
onChange.en-US: Called when the tab changes, with the itemKey of the new active tab.

onTabClick.zh-CN: 单击，或用 Enter、Space 激活标签页时调用；用键盘激活时事件是 KeyboardEvent。
onTabClick.en-US: Called when a tab is clicked or activated with Enter or Space; the event is a KeyboardEvent for keyboard activation.

onTabClose.zh-CN: 关闭标签页时调用，参数为被关闭标签页的 itemKey。标签页的移除由使用方完成。
onTabClose.en-US: Called when a tab is closed, with the itemKey of the closed tab. The caller removes the tab.

onVisibleTabsChange.zh-CN: 折叠模式下溢出项的可见状态变化时调用，参数为 itemKey 到是否可见的 Map。
onVisibleTabsChange.en-US: In collapsible mode, called when the visibility of the tabs changes, with a Map from itemKey to whether it is visible.

panel.zh-CN: `tabList` 中每个标签页内容的 snippet，参数为 `{ item, index, itemKey }`；传入后每个标签页都是各自的 tabpanel，`keepDOM`、`lazyRender` 与切换动画对它生效。
panel.en-US: Snippet for the content of each `tabList` entry, with `{ item, index, itemKey }`; it makes every entry its own tabpanel, and `keepDOM`, `lazyRender` and motion apply.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 组件内部调用 focus 时，是否阻止浏览器滚动文档以显示新聚焦的元素。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether focus calls inside the component stop the browser from scrolling the document to the newly focused element.

showRestInDropdown.zh-CN: 折叠模式下，是否将被收起的标签页展示在下拉菜单中。
showRestInDropdown.en-US: In collapsible mode, whether the collapsed tabs are listed in a dropdown menu.

size.zh-CN: 标签栏尺寸，目前仅线条式（line）标签栏支持。
size.en-US: Size of the tab bar; currently only the line type supports it.

tab.zh-CN: `tabList` 中每个标签页标签的 snippet，参数为 `{ item, index }`；不提供时显示该项的 `tab` 文本。
tab.en-US: Snippet for the tab of each `tabList` entry, with `{ item, index }`; without it the entry's `tab` text shows.

tabBar.zh-CN: 替换整个标签栏的 snippet。参数 `{ tabBarProps, tabBar }`：`tabBarProps` 只含数据，`tabBar` 是默认标签栏，用 `{@render tabBar()}` 渲染；自定义标签栏里的 TabItem 会自行控制所在的 Tabs。
tabBar.en-US: Snippet that replaces the whole tab bar, with `{ tabBarProps, tabBar }`: `tabBarProps` holds data only and `tabBar` is the default tab bar, rendered with `{@render tabBar()}`; a TabItem inside the custom bar controls its Tabs on its own.

tabBarClassName.en-US: Class name of the tab bar.

tabBarExtraContent.zh-CN: 标签栏附加内容的 snippet，位于 tablist 之外。
tabBarExtraContent.en-US: Snippet for the extra content of the tab bar, placed outside the tablist.

tabBarStyle.en-US: Style string of the tab bar.

tabList.zh-CN: 标签页的数据数组，每项含 itemKey、tab、disabled、closable，只放数据；标签内的节点用 `tab` 与 `icon` snippet，内容用 `panel` snippet 或 `children`。
tabList.en-US: An array of tab data, each with itemKey, tab, disabled and closable, data only. Tab markup goes in the `tab` and `icon` snippets, and the content in the `panel` snippet or `children`.

tabPaneMotion.zh-CN: 是否使用动画切换面板。

tabPosition.zh-CN: 标签栏位置：top 为水平，left 为垂直。
tabPosition.en-US: Position of the tab bar: top is horizontal, left is vertical.

type.zh-CN: 标签栏样式：line、card、button、slash。slash 仅支持水平模式。
type.en-US: Style of the tab bar: line, card, button or slash. slash supports horizontal mode only.

visibleTabsStyle.zh-CN: 折叠模式下，整体滚动区域的样式字符串。
visibleTabsStyle.en-US: In collapsible mode, the style string of the whole scrolling area.

closable.en-US: Whether to show the close button.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用；禁用时点击、关闭按钮与 Enter、Space、Delete、Backspace 键均不生效，关闭按钮仍会显示。
disabled.en-US: Whether the tab is disabled; clicks, the close button and the Enter, Space, Delete and Backspace keys have no effect, while the close button still shows.

icon.zh-CN: 标签图标的 snippet；图标容器始终渲染，即使 snippet 没有输出。
icon.en-US: Snippet for the tab icon; the icon container renders even when the snippet outputs nothing.

onClick.zh-CN: 点击标签时调用，参数为 itemKey 与事件；禁用时不调用。在 Tabs 之内，点击本身已会选中该标签页。
onClick.en-US: Called when the tab is clicked, with the itemKey and the event; not called while disabled. Inside a Tabs the click already selects the tab.

size.zh-CN: 尺寸，默认取所在 Tabs 的 size。
size.en-US: Size; defaults to the size of the enclosing Tabs.

tabPosition.zh-CN: 位置，默认取所在 Tabs 的 tabPosition，在 Tabs 之外为 top。
tabPosition.en-US: Position; defaults to the tabPosition of the enclosing Tabs, else top.

type.zh-CN: 样式，默认取所在 Tabs 的 type，在 Tabs 之外为 line。
type.en-US: Style; defaults to the type of the enclosing Tabs, else line.
